title: LifeOS join/companion/results require login (confidential personal life)
problem: Open join + token URLs exposed confidential daily-life tracking without account binding.
fix: LifeOS login issues customer session cookies (any account; not admin-only).
POST /lifeos/join stamps OwnerUserId; one personal client per account.
Companion APIs reject invalid tokens (no silent test-client fallback).
Clients board / directory require login; /cp/lifeos-clients-app requires admin again.
flow: Sign in → /lifeos/join → companion/results bound to account
prove: curl -sL -X POST https://lifeos.ecomae.com/lifeos/join -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json' -d '{}' | head
